titleEn: Hear a Rumble? Middle of the Alley!

pages.text: "Cosiest here!" Nono, the smallest, roundest sparrow, sat in a dry spot beneath the roof edge. Sunshine gleamed on the roof snow. "I will watch all the snow from here!" He tucked his scarf close.
Gugu, the broad-chested pigeon, beckoned from the alley middle. "Come out, Nono!" Water dripped from the icicles. "A little longer!" Nono leaned against the wall.
Kiki, the pointy-eared cat, pricked up the ears. "Rumble... What is that?" Roof snow was sliding. Gugu grabbed Nono's hand and pulled him into the alley middle.
Thump! A lump of snow fell behind them. Snow piled where Nono had been sitting. All three stood unhurt in the middle, wide-eyed.
Grandpa Badger came out with a broom. "Everyone all right?" He tapped the snow pile. "Sunshine makes roof snow slide like this."
Grandpa pointed to the alley middle. "Stand here and look up." Nono saw open sky, hidden under the roof edge. "Nothing above you here, so no snow falls on you."
Nono raised both hands. "Hear a rumble? Middle of the alley!" Kiki and Gugu joined him there.
Another rumble came. All three moved two steps into the middle at once. Nono touched his green scarf. "Not scared at all!"
On sunny days, Nono looked up at the roof. "One, hear a rumble? Middle of the alley! Two, stand where you see sky! Three, no playing under roof edges!" Next sunny day, he left that spot first.
Grandpa brushed snow from Nono's forehead. At a rumble, come straight into the alley middle. Nono looked up at the sky. "Hear a rumble? Middle of the alley!"
